description: This file defines a React functional component named InvoiceType that provides a user interface for selecting an invoice type via a modal dialog. It uses Material-UI components for styling and interaction, including buttons, dialogs, and select menus.

methods.name: InvoiceType
methods.description: React functional component that renders a button and dialog for selecting an invoice type, managing open/close state and handling selection changes.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates the invoice type state when a new selection is made from the dropdown menu.
